# DCM Core Institute

> Independent research and data on tokenized capital markets: digital bonds, tokenized treasuries and money-market funds, the EU DLT Pilot Regime, MiCA and DORA. Content is published in French (/fr/, default) and English (/en/). Figures are dated snapshots with their source; nothing on this site is investment advice.

## Start here
- [DCM Core Institute — home (FR)](https://dcmcore.com/fr/) · [Home (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/)
- [About the institute (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/about.html) · [À propos (FR)](https://dcmcore.com/fr/about.html)
- [Editorial standards (EN)](https://dcmcore.com/en/about/editorial-standards.html): sourcing and corrections policy
